verdict.rationale: No evidence pack item addresses AI training data opt-out or any policy preventing use of customer data for AI model training; Amplitude's AI features (docs-10, docs-34) and MCP server (docs-11/17) are about surfacing data via AI, not about consent/controls over training use. Missing for 10: explicit privacy policy or setting on AI training data usage, opt-out mechanism, or documentation addressing this concern.
